sources.entry: Kap - Screen recorder application built with web technology.

summary.one_liner: Kap is an open-source screen recorder for macOS built with web technology, controlled from the menu bar.
summary.what_it_does: Kap records part or all of the screen from a menu bar icon: you pick the area, press record, and click the icon again to stop. While recording, Option-click pauses and right-click opens more options. The README offers downloads for Apple silicon and Intel, plus installation through Homebrew Cask. It has a plugin system with documented plugin creation, and it links to a website and a related repository called Aperture. The README also describes dev builds of the main branch and other branches, which are unsupported. Contribution guidance is linked from the README but not detailed in it.
use_cases: capture a portion of the screen
screen recording from the menu bar
how_to_run: Or download the latest release for Apple silicon or Intel from the README links
Click the menu bar icon, select the screen area, and press record
notable: Menu bar app with pause via Option-click while recording
Plugin system with documented plugin creation
Ships builds for Apple silicon and Intel Macs
caveats: Dev builds from other branches are unsupported and may have issues
README describes only macOS usage; no other platforms are mentioned
